cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Leave the director's name on the launch programme. The department heads need someone above them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her resignation is in the printer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Put it in my drawer. Without her, they'll each claim the launch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're asking which of them gets her opening speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read it on her behalf. Give them equal introductions; nobody inherits the microphone.

mechanism: A applies professional programme and speaking-order corrections to conceal a director resignation and prevent competing heads from claiming the vacant authority.
confusable: D61 conceals A own responsibility; D63 hides destabilising truth to preserve the existing balance rather than personal innocence.
comparison: Fair alternative preserves confidence in one chair through private finance repair; launch alternative prevents departmental succession conflict.
seedUse: Director resignation, printer, department heads and opening speech derive from D63-a; S03 adds exact programme and introduction control.
